# The actual signed S05 daemon lacks retention methods.
server start
taskfile task.json success
skygo --json run -f task.json --wait
job-id JOB
event-count 1
calls GetRetention 1
calls SubmitJob 1
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain 11111111111111111111111111111111:1 --request-id explicit
stderr 'unimplemented'
calls SubmitRetainedJob 1
calls SubmitJob 1
! skygo jobs retention
stderr 'unimplemented'
! skygo jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z
stderr 'unimplemented'
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --cursor eA
stderr 'unimplemented'
calls StreamRetainedJobLogs 1
calls StreamJobLogs 0
calls PlanTask 0
event-count 1
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^retained workload output\n$'
calls StreamJobLogs 1
# Genuine old retry method, without fallback from its actual reply (Linux).
[linux-retry] taskfile retry.json failonce
[linux-retry] skygo --json run -f retry.json --wait
[linux-retry] calls SubmitRetryJob 1
[linux-retry] calls SubmitJob 1
[linux-retry] event-count 3
server stop
! stderr .
